title: The Body of Mary by Katie Cappiello at The Gym at Judson #thebodyofma...
transcript: Act two of this brilliant triptych is certified ragebait. In this urgent and unsettling but hilarious new play, we see three Marys across three eras, each saddled with an uninvited and unimaginable responsibility. Without giving too much away, I will say it evokes a rollercoaster of emotions through its relentless and incisive takedown of the Catholic Church. While it's clear that playwright and director Katie Cappiello is concerned with the agency that has been stripped from countless women over centuries, this play isn't a TED talk. It's a smartly crafted trio of distinctly ridiculous stories in effortless conversation with one another. What seals the deal is how well it balances its heavy subject matter with its abundance of humor, in all sorts of flavors — dark comedy, satire, and straight up absurdism. The performances from the ensemble cast are similarly compelling, creating a liminal space that blurs reality with dystopian fantasy. And by the end, it's clear that our present is as dystopian as our greatest fears. The Body of Mary is currently running at The Gym at Judson through October 8th. With that, another program for my collection.
